name: epic: Move the skill suite to Bevy 0.20
description:
Bevy 0.20.0 shipped on 2026-10-08 and 0.20.1 on 2026-10-28 (crates.io). Every current skill pins 0.19, so agents in variant-club, ppw-client, ppw-server and RetroFeel get stale guidance. ppw-client has already migrated to Bevy 0.20.0 (chrisgliddon/ppw-client, commits around 2026-10-28 and 29). Lessons it found:
- Bevy 0.20 requires rustc 1.97.1.
- Custom shaders were ported to WESL (water, prop_fade, voxel_surface_atlas, party_character plus its prepass, and the far lens re-forked from 0.20's dof.wesl).
- Morph targets are indexed by descriptor.
- bevy_rapier3d 0.37.0 pairs with 0.20.
User direction (2026-11-01): central Bevy kits shared by every game agent, with minimal duplication.

Plan: follow the CLAUDE.md maintenance cadence:
- Bump the bevy-skills-tester crate to bevy 0.20.1 and rustc 1.97.1.
- Write a new bevy-migration-0-19-to-0-20 skill, built from the official 0.20 migration guide and ppw-client's real migration commits.
- Bump every current skill's pin to 0.20, and fix snippets until cargo check --examples is clean.
- Update the router.
Compile the tester crate on a build host through the shared Deck build kit (RetroFeel epic 22kmwzc7) or another non-laptop host, never on the laptop.
